1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
9: 
10:   const player = {
11:     x: 50,
12:     y: height - 30,
13:     w: 20,
14:     h: 30,
15:     vy: 0,
16:     jumpStrength: -8,
17:     onGround: true,
18:     draw() { ctx.fillStyle = '#4CAF50'; ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h); },
19:     update() {
20:       this.vy += 0.4; // gravity
21:       this.y += this.vy;
22:       if (this.y + this.h >= height) { this.y = height - this.h; this.vy = 0; this.onGround = true; } else { this.onGround = false; }
23:     },
24:     jump() { if (this.onGround) { this.vy = this.jumpStrength; this.onGround = false; } }
25:   };
26: 
27:   // obstacles: simple rectangles moving left
28:   const obstacles = [];
29:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
30:   const obstacleInterval = 120; // frames
31:   let score = 0;
32:   let gameOver = false;
33: 
34:   function spawnObstacle() {
35:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
36:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
37:     obstacles.push({ x: width, y: height - h, w, h, passed: false });
38:   }
39: 
40:   function updateObstacles() {
41:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
42:       const o = obstacles[i];
43:       o.x -= 3; // speed
44:       // collision
45:       if (!gameOver &&
46:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
47:           player.x + player.w > o.x &&
48:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
49:           player.y + player.h > o.y) {
50:         gameOver = true;
51:       }
52:       // remove off‑screen
53:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
54:     }
55:   }
56: 
57:   function drawObstacles() {
58:     ctx.fillStyle = '#D32F2F';
59:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
60:   }
61: 
62:   function drawScore() {
63:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
64:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';

70:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
71:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
72:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
73:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
74:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2-60, height/2);
75:       return;
76:     }
77:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
78:     player.update();
79:     player.draw();
